what: A second fresh fixture, today, no model: Continue, walk, leave Play (the land writes the day's visit), Continue again, walk more, quit from Play: one visit for the day, none written on quit

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ head: w.now.head.n, visits: Object.values(w.now.events).filter(e => e.kind === 'visit').length }) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (w.status !== 'ready') return JSON.stringify(w.status); return JSON.stringify({ screen: S.useSessionStore.getState().screen, head: w.value.now.head.n, visits: Object.values(w.value.now.events).filter(e => e.kind === 'visit').map(e => ({ n: e.n, chunks: e.body.chunks })) }) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()
